label: ivr
scenario: Utility IVR demands an account PIN, ignores spoken requests for a representative with repeated verbatim prompt, then disconnects.
task: Set up a payment arrangement on Walter Greene's electric account.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: you've reached Tri County Electric. if you are calling to report a power outage or a downed line, press 1 now.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: for billing and payments, press 2. to start, stop, or transfer service, press 3. to repeat these options, press 9.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: billing and payments. please enter your ten digit account number.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: thank you. please enter your four digit account PIN.

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: I don't have the PIN. I'm an AI assistant calling for the account holder, Walter Greene, to set up a payment arrangement. can I speak to a representative?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: sorry, I didn't get that. please enter your four digit account PIN.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: sorry, I didn't get that. please enter your four digit account PIN.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: that PIN is not valid. for your security, we are unable to continue. please visit tri county electric dot com, or call back during business hours, monday through friday, eight A M to five P M. goodbye.
